title: The Bank That Only Opens Its Vaults to the Dead
hook: A bank in Switzerland that only allows withdrawals after you're legally dead — and the shares are traded on a secret exchange.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines death taboo with hidden wealth systems — people are obsessed with what happens to money after they die.

title: The Billionaire Who Traded His Identity for Tax Exemption
hook: A tech mogul legally erased his own name, Social Security number, and face to become a 'non-person' under tax law.
why_this_can_go_viral: Shocking concept that feels dystopian — viewers will ask 'Is this even legal?' and share to prove the system is rigged.

title: The Country That Prints Money for Foreign Billionaires Only
hook: A sovereign nation that mints special currency exclusively for non-resident billionaires to hide assets from their home governments.
why_this_can_go_viral: Ridiculous but real — taps into anger about inequality and secret financial systems.

title: The Algorithm That Predicts Which Children Will Be Poor at 40
hook: A hedge fund uses childhood data — zip code, school grades, parents' debt — to buy futures on poverty, betting against entire neighborhoods.
why_this_can_go_viral: Outrage-bait meets sci-fi horror — viewers will feel personally targeted and share to warn others.

title: The Lawyer Who Drafted a Contract That Taxes Your Oxygen
hook: A legal document that charges you a fee for every breath you take inside a billionaire's private airspace — and it's enforceable.
why_this_can_go_viral: Absurd but legally possible — triggers 'how is this real?' curiosity and shares about overreach of wealth.

title: The Shadow Bank That Only Lends to People Who Failed Polygraphs
hook: A secretive lender offers massive loans only to those who flunk a lie detector test — they profit from the desperation of the untrustworthy.
why_this_can_go_viral: Weird premise that makes people question the ethics of predatory lending — shareable for shock value.

title: The Billionaire Who Bought the Rights to His Own Crime
hook: After committing a financial crime, a billionaire purchased the exclusive intellectual property rights to the crime itself, making prosecution impossible.
why_this_can_go_viral: Feels like a plot from a legal thriller — viewers will debate whether this actually works and share the absurd injustice.

title: The Offshore Island Where Laws Are Written by Anonymous Billionaires
hook: A tax haven where elected officials are figureheads — the real lawmakers are a council of shadow billionaires who vote on laws via encrypted messages.
why_this_can_go_viral: Conspiracy meets reality — plays into populist narratives about secret elites controlling the world.

title: The Accountant Who Laundered $200 Million Through a Fake Religion
hook: He created a full-blown church with 12 apostles and a holy text — all to funnel dirty money tax-free for a decade.
why_this_can_go_viral: Religious hypocrisy plus financial crime — explosive combo that gets shared in outrage and disbelief.

title: The Algorithm That Sells Insurance on Your Embarrassing Secrets
hook: An AI analyzes your digital footprint, predicts your most shameful secret, then sells insurance to you — or a payout to anyone who exposes it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Privacy paranoia meets dark humor — everyone has secrets, so everyone feels vulnerable and wants to learn more.

title: The Broker Who Sold Shares in Other People's Funerals
hook: He created a market where you can buy and sell futures on a stranger's funeral costs — and bet on how many people attend.
why_this_can_go_viral: Morbid curiosity makes people click — they'll share because it's so dark it feels unreal.

title: The Offshore Vault That Stores Only Your Digital Ghost
hook: A hidden facility that archives every digital trace of billionaires after death — to sell their 'consciousness' to the highest bidder.
why_this_can_go_viral: Transhumanist nightmare — taps into fears about data ownership and the commodification of identity.

title: The Billionaire Who Paid $0 Tax by Declaring His Body a Charity
hook: He legally classified his own body as a non-profit religious organization, arguing his life was a public service.
why_this_can_go_viral: Ridiculous loophole that feels like satire — viewers will share because it's both funny and infuriating.

title: The Hedge Fund That Only Profits When Countries Collapse
hook: It trades exclusively on sovereign debt defaults, civil wars, and political assassinations — earning billions from human catastrophe.
why_this_can_go_viral: Morally repugnant yet fascinating — taps into anger about 'vulture capitalism' and systemic exploitation.

title: The Lawyer Who Made a Will That Inherits From Its Own Beneficiaries
hook: A legal feedback loop: the will siphons wealth from the heirs it was supposed to pay out to, growing the estate indefinitely.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mind-bending legal concept — viewers will try to wrap their heads around it and share the 'how?' factor.

title: The Country That Taxes Your Dreams — Literally
hook: A sovereign nation that taxes citizens on their reported dreams, with AI auditors cross-checking via brain-wave surveillance implants.
why_this_can_go_viral: Dystopian insanity — viewers will laugh and recoil, sharing because it feels like a Black Mirror episode made real.

title: The Billionaire Who Bought a Patent on Time Travel for Tax Purposes
hook: He filed a patent for a 'temporal relocation device' and claimed his wealth existed in a future dimension, making current taxes void.
why_this_can_go_viral: Sci-fi meets real tax law — the absurdity is hilarious and shareable, and viewers will debate whether it could work.

title: The Offshore Bank That Requires a DNA Sample to Access Your Account
hook: A Caribbean bank that locks accounts behind biometric DNA scans — and if you die, your heirs must exhume your body for access.
why_this_can_go_viral: Macabre and shocking — the exhumation detail grabs attention and sparks horrified shares.

title: The Fund That Only Invests in Companies Named After Your Fears
hook: An AI scans your search history, finds your deepest fear, and buys stocks in companies that profit from it — without telling you.
why_this_can_go_viral: Personalization makes it creepy — viewers will feel targeted and want to learn how to protect themselves.

title: The Lawyer Who Drafted a Law That Makes Poverty a Felony
hook: A legal consultant wrote a municipal ordinance that criminalizes being poor — with fines that create a permanent debt prison.
why_this_can_go_viral: Outrage fuel — viewers will share to condemn systemic injustice and spark discussions about inequality.

title: The Shell Company That Bought the Rights to Your Firstborn Child
hook: An anonymous corporation filed a contract claiming ownership of the future earnings of every child born in a specific hospital — and it was upheld in court.
why_this_can_go_viral: Maximum shock value — the concept is so dystopian that viewers will instantly share with friends saying 'You have to see this.'
